_comment: Routine action kind `system` (mchatai_macOS/docs/ROUTINES_ARCHITECTURE.md §3.3). The handler list and each handler's defaults live in routines/system.json; the handler enum here must list exactly those ids, which must match RoutineSystemHandlerID.known in Swift (checked by scripts/check_routine_content.py). Handler-specific params (forYouBrief takes today's AssistantRoutine fields) pass through.
summary: One of mChatAI+'s own background jobs.
help: Built-in upkeep and briefing jobs. Their schedules can be changed and they can be switched off; what they do is part of mChatAI+.
